title: AIO Standards Pack
description: A modular, versioned formalization of an external reference norm into AIO Framework hierarchy values (V/E/S). A pack is data, not code: adding a pack adds a certification product without a code change. Certificates pin the pack id and version so that a later revision of the source norm does not retroactively change the meaning of an earlier certificate.

$schema.description: Optional pointer back to this schema, for editor validation.

id.description: Stable pack identifier. Lowercase, hyphenated. Certificates reference `{id}@{version}`.

name.description: Display name per locale. `en` is required; other locales fall back to `en`.

sourceNorm.description: The external reference standard being formalized. AIO certifies conformance to AIO's formalization of this norm — never conformance certified by the norm's issuing body.

vesMapping.description: Article-by-article mapping from the source norm to AIO hierarchy expectations. Each entry is validated through the public RFC process before the pack leaves `draft`.

status.description: Verification stage of this single mapping entry (execution plan §5.3.5.3). `draft-unverified` = seeded, never checked against the primary source. `draft-verified` = the quote in `provenance` was read from the official text and the V/E/S assignment was re-derived from it. `rfc` = under public review. `active` = may back an issued certificate.

provenance.description: Primary-source evidence for this entry (execution plan §5.3.5.2). Mandatory before an entry may leave `draft-unverified`. Only the official publication of the norm counts as a source — never a commentary, summary, or blog.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical URL of the official text the quote was read from.

retrievalUrl.description: Optional. The endpoint actually fetched, when it differs from the canonical citation URL (e.g. the EU Publications Office Cellar mirror of a EUR-Lex document).

article.description: Exact provision the quote comes from, down to the paragraph and point.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt of the official text, normally 400 characters or fewer. Elisions are marked […]. A bracketed citation such as [Art. 9(1)] may precede an excerpt when one entry quotes more than one provision; everything outside brackets is verbatim.

rationale.description: Why this provision maps to these V/E/S codes, argued from the quoted text.

retrievedAt.description: ISO 8601 date the official text was fetched.

verifiedBy.description: Who or what performed the check, and what review stage it is at.

changeNote.description: What changed in this entry relative to the previous pack version, and why.

article.description: Citation of the provision in the source norm, as the norm itself numbers it.

summary.description: One-sentence statement of what the provision requires, in neutral terms.

v.description: Value hierarchy (L4) codes the provision expects to prevail. From pack version 0.2 onward these are the canonical three-letter AIO 00011 codes (Sep, Ses, Cor, …) served at /api/framework/vocabulary — the same codes an AIO 20002 record carries.

e.description: Evidence hierarchy (L3) codes the provision expects to be decisive. Canonical three-letter AIO 00011 codes (Gui, Dat, Cas, …).

s.description: Source hierarchy (L2) codes the provision expects to be trusted. Canonical three-letter AIO 00011 codes (Gov, Ind, Pro, …).

note.description: Optional caveat. Entries carrying `draft` in this field are placeholders awaiting RFC validation.

itemBankRef.description: References to the scenario item banks used for scoring. The public set is served as static JSON; the private set lives in Firestore and is never exposed, so that Tier 1+ scores cannot be gamed against a known bank.

publicSet.description: Path or URL of the public item set. `null` while the bank is not yet built.

privateSet.description: Firestore collection path of the private, rotating item set. Always `null` in the published pack file.

version.description: Semantic version of this pack. Any change to `vesMapping` requires a version bump.

status.description: Lifecycle stage (execution plan §5.3.5.3): draft-unverified → draft-verified → rfc → active. A pack is `draft-verified` only when EVERY vesMapping entry is `draft-verified`; a single unverified entry holds the whole pack at `draft-unverified`. Only `active` packs may back a certificate without a draft-basis notice. `draft` is the pre-§5.3.5 spelling, retained so that packs written before the provenance regime still load.

deprecatedBy.description: Version of the pack that supersedes this one. Present only on `deprecated` packs. The file is kept so that certificates pinned to this version remain resolvable.

supersedes.description: Version this pack replaces, if any.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 date of the last change to this pack.

notes.description: Free-form guardrails and limitations shown alongside the pack.
